['Fuchs Petrolub SE '].company_description: Fuchs Petrolub SE is a German multinational manufacturer of lubricants and related specialty products. The company's headquarters are in Mannheim, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, where it was founded in 1931. Fuchs is a public company listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the MDAX trading index of German mid-cap companies.

['Salzgitter Mannesmann Handel GmbH '].company_description: Salzgitter Mannesmann Handel GmbH operates as a producer of steel and steel products. The company operates through five segments, including the Strip Steel segment, which produces strip steel in a wide variety of metallurgic compositions and dimensions.
